header: Empties track (0x0C70): frees its chain (BStore_FreeChain via T_F42888), marks its directory entry empty and resets its saved cursors in the workspace and in the current bank's copy (0x610000 + BStore_CurrentBank*0xC00). Called by TRACK CLEAR (SongEdit_ClearTrack_Call), SongEdit_DeleteMeasuresFromTrack, SongEdit_CopyMeasuresToTrack and TrackMerge_Execute; twin of the block store's BStore_ClearTrack. Basis: callers + body.
review: reviewer-authored, from the evidence batches p and q cite for it
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139279 `calr	sub_F6079E` -- the whole body of the TRACK CLEAR slot routine sub_F6079A (T_F426E4)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135884 `calr	sub_F6079E` -- MEASURE DELETE from measure 1 to the end clears the whole track
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137826 `calr	sub_F6079E` -- MEASURE COPY clears a freshly created destination chain on error
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138501 `calr	sub_F6079E` -- TRACK MERGE clears the destination when it is neither source
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139341 `call	T_F42888` -- frees the old chain (T_F42888 -> calr BStore_FreeChain)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139356 `ld	xix, 6356992` -- repeats the directory / cursor reset in bank copy 0x610000 + BStore_CurrentBank*0xC00
